fragments.html:
Intent picker: names only
The source gives each segment a Label with a symbol (sunrise, sunset, sun.horizon, moon.stars), but the macOS segmented control in the snapshots shows the names only. The snapshot is followed.
Add to Trip is prominent
SpotHeaderView sets .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent) on the Add to Trip menu and SCREENS.md says "prominent menu"; the snapshots show it as a plain bordered button. Source followed.
Best tab colour
COMPONENTS.md says the Best tab is accent/primary; the source (WhenToGoView.swift) uses accent/emphasis. Source followed.

Weather symbols are single-colour here
The app renders the hourly symbols with .symbolRenderingMode(.multicolor); the symbol export is one weight and one colour, so they are drawn in text/secondary.
